messages:
Maya (Design): dropping a fresh responsive pass for the console list view. main concerns: sidebar collapse at tiny widths, table overflow behavior, and a lightweight drag-to-dismiss for the filter sheet. plz test on real phones and flag any layout jitter. :mag:
Priya (Product): thanks. leaning toward keeping a compact two-line row between 480-520px so power users don't lose density. avoid switching straight to cards until <=400px.
Elaine (Frontend): prototype currently switches at 500px -> compressed rows, and 390px -> stacked cards. css snippet: 
```
@media (max-width:500px){.row--compressed{height:56px}}
@media (max-width:390px){.results-table{display:none}.stacked-cards{display:block}}
```
Elaine (Frontend): note: when sheet opens and input is focused, iOS keyboard covers bottom actions. plan: listen to `visualViewport` and add `.keyboard-open` to the sheet to bump up actions. will debounce resize so we don't flip layout mid-scroll.
Nora (A11y): accessibility checklist: 1) keep table semantics while DOM is a table; 2) when switching to cards, add `role=\"list\"` + `role=\"listitem\"`; 3) announce sheet open/close via `aria-live=\"polite\"`; 4) close button must have `aria-label=\"Close filters\"`.
Maya (Design): copy tweak: header should read "Filter results" (not "Filters"). floating sort pill label: "Sort: Most relevant" and visible to SR users. add a small drag handle visually but ensure a clear close button.
Priya (Product): analytics: emit `filter.layout_change` with the new layout id and `filter.keyboard_open_submit` when keyboard was present on submit. helps triage support.
Elaine (Frontend): will add instrumentation hooks and sticky sort pill via `position: sticky; top: env(safe-area-inset-top,16px);`. also will implement ellipsis on compressed rows: `text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden;`.
QA (Mobile): test plan posted: devices iPhone 11/12/13 mini, iPhone SE (2nd gen), Pixel 6. check breakpoints @500 & 390, keyboard open behavior, drag-to-dismiss vs scroll, preserved selected row after nav back, sticky sort pill stays visible.
Maya (Design): small visual request: reduce avatar from 36->30 at <=420px, title font 14->13 at <=360px to avoid wrap. will update figma and add annotations for sticky pill spacing. link: https://www.figma.com/file/example/mobile-console-breakpoints
Nora (A11y): chips must be keyboard-focusable with `role=\"button\"` and `aria-pressed` when active. ensure color contrast >=4.5:1. if truncating chips, add `aria-describedby` with full text.
Elaine (Frontend): quick implementation note: if we flip DOM from table->list, update focus management so returning users land on the same item. we'll persist selected id in route state.
DeployBot: preview build: https://staging.redwood.internal/mobile-stack-1945 (build 2026.03.24-07) :rocket:
Priya (Product): i'll test on SE and Pixel and drop screenshots here. if no regressions, we'll adopt 500->390 breakpoints with the compaction tweak at 480 as a follow-up.
Maya (Design): thanks everyone. i'll add QA checklist to ticket INF-1217 and upload final frames. please comment inline on figma if you spot spacing/keyboard issues. closing after device checks. :white_check_mark:
